type.description: the package manager installing the tool

parent.description: the tool this tool depends on, eg. composer depends on php

deprecated.description: deprecated tools should not be used any more

root.description: the tool can only be installed as root, so only at image build time

minVersion.description: the oldest version containerbase supports for the tool, in the tool's versioning; tools without a known limit have none

propertyNames.description: an Ubuntu release supported by containerbase, by codename

distroMinVersion.description: the oldest version containerbase supports on an Ubuntu release, in the tool's versioning, keyed by codename; only for releases whose floor differs from minVersion, which is the floor on noble

tools.description: all supported tools, keyed by tool name
